title: Crochet Effect in CLO 🧶
content:
Want to recreate this cozy crochet flower texture in CLO? Here's how I did it using the **Knitwear material settings**!  
👇 These are the parameters I used:

🧵 **Stitching** : Stockinette  
🧶 **Yarn Thickness** : 7.00  
📏 **Gauge** : 2.20  
📍 **Generate Seams** : ON  
🔁 **Length** : 100 mm  
🌙 **Curvature** : 0.5  
✨ **Reflection Roughness** : 50

I also played with **Yarn Variance** and a soft **melange effect** to give it depth and realism. Perfect for playful and soft designs like this floral dress! 

Let me know if you try it! 

![ea367a04031f4b91ba8ed9a431481490](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/ad24327810c546b48268ccae2c4a9f37/images/ea367a04031f4b91ba8ed9a431481490Captura%20de%20pantalla%202025-06-15%20113905.png)![8b3600c97db14bc9a4ab86604d7260ef](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/ad24327810c546b48268ccae2c4a9f37/images/8b3600c97db14bc9a4ab86604d7260efCaptura%20de%20pantalla%202025-06-15%20113945.png)![479d1dbe1da24cba91a9cfc373e5c329](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/ad24327810c546b48268ccae2c4a9f37/images/479d1dbe1da24cba91a9cfc373e5c329Captura%20de%20pantalla%202025-06-15%20113958.png)![d339cdbe19074d82a5f4ff4c9790d222](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/ad24327810c546b48268ccae2c4a9f37/images/d339cdbe19074d82a5f4ff4c9790d222Captura%20de%20pantalla%202025-06-15%20114014.png)

title: Problem with Clo Sync 5.5 and 5.6
content:
Hello guys, i'm working on a garment on CLO, I want to use it in UE5.5 or 5.6 but in each version I got the right Live sync for each version :   


  * For UE 5.5 I got this one : CLO LiveSync 2.0.0![8fb5ac0500aa4e0bb95143e378671f56](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/4f74d309b1d24ff195e0f7643ba89676/images/8fb5ac0500aa4e0bb95143e378671f56Capture%20d%27%C3%A9cran%202025-06-13%20213857.png)



  * and for UE 5.6 I installed the Fab plug in : ![5068078f7f0f4f309bb5e35489c2c37e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/4f74d309b1d24ff195e0f7643ba89676/images/5068078f7f0f4f309bb5e35489c2c37eimage.png)

  * I'm using this version of CLO 3D ![e48ffad753ef4f64af573a11251f96df](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/4f74d309b1d24ff195e0f7643ba89676/images/e48ffad753ef4f64af573a11251f96dfCapture%20d%27%C3%A9cran%202025-06-13%20212715.png)

  * Finally, i'm doing every steps like check the plug-in in my UE project but i still have no windows idk why ![b6f891c3c09745b68c4fa499f50287fd](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/4f74d309b1d24ff195e0f7643ba89676/images/b6f891c3c09745b68c4fa499f50287fdCapture%20d%27%C3%A9cran%202025-06-13%20211635.png)

Can anyone help me please ?

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi machiavhell.3d,the LiveSync Editor has been removed, and a new LiveSync Mode has been added in CLO LiveSync 2.0.0, allowing users to work directly in the scene instead of opening a separate editor. For more information, please check out the documentation about using LiveSync Mode! https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/4f74d309b1d24ff195e0f7643ba89676 use CLO LiveSync with UE 5.6, you need the newest version, CLO LiveSync 2.0.1. It can be found on Fab and you can install it to the engine directly in Epic Games Launcher. It is explained in this announcement: https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/4f74d309b1d24ff195e0f7643ba89676 regards,Bryan
Reply 1: Hey Bryan, thanks for your answer, I found the section of Clo3D Sync, everything work perfectly thanks <3333

title: Kling AI Experiment: Avatar Transitions and Realism
content:
# ✨️**Exploring _Kling AI_ for Enhanced Avatar Renders and Transitions✨️**

Hi everyone!  
In this post, I’d like to share a recent experiment where I used **Kling AI** to enhance the realism of my avatar renders and create smoother transitions between poses.

![cea42fee163a484c9257fb551def7258](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/20d2fae3d9e64e1ba1e875849b4a8483/images/cea42fee163a484c9257fb551def7258YouCut_20250612_071032878-ezgif.com-video-to-webp-converter-2.webp)

* * *

For this project, I used 3 different renders.

![d175ff247f9f46fe87280d0185da57f9](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/20d2fae3d9e64e1ba1e875849b4a8483/images/d175ff247f9f46fe87280d0185da57f951-2-1.JPG)

I used two of them — one as the starting frame and one as the ending frame — to showcase a transformation. Then, I used the **YouCut** app simply to stitch the two short video clips together, creating a seamless visual flow.

![ea2ea68c3b734cfbb16aebf5ca8a6d0c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/20d2fae3d9e64e1ba1e875849b4a8483/images/ea2ea68c3b734cfbb16aebf5ca8a6d0cScreenshot_20250612-082640_Gallery.jpg)

The results were quite promising. Kling AI added a dynamic and lifelike quality to the avatars that made the scene feel more animated and expressive.

* * *

While the results were quite promising in some cases, I also had several failed attempts. For example, in some of the test videos below, the outputs didn’t turn out well due to unclear camera angles, using only a single reference image, overly long or vague prompts, or excessive avatar motion. These factors often led to unnatural or broken animations.

![c726f1eb9a4f42f5b6823f48f3cd5b21](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/20d2fae3d9e64e1ba1e875849b4a8483/images/c726f1eb9a4f42f5b6823f48f3cd5b2120250612_060527613-ezgif.com-video-to-webp-converter.webp)![8847a312affd4c4cb8faef2939b1bd67](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/20d2fae3d9e64e1ba1e875849b4a8483/images/8847a312affd4c4cb8faef2939b1bd6720250612_061319862-ezgif.com-video-to-webp-converter.webp)![aa2b66361244460f916ecf083224f08f](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/20d2fae3d9e64e1ba1e875849b4a8483/images/aa2b66361244460f916ecf083224f08f20250612_061311259-ezgif.com-video-to-webp-converter.webp)

Still, it's been a valuable learning process — and I'm excited to keep experimenting and refining the workflow!

* * *
